spans.s:
or (-इ.) कदि r. 1st cl. (कदते and कन्दते)
1 To be confused, to suffer mentally, to grieve.
2 To confound.
3 To kill or hurt;
also कदि, (कंदति)
1 To call.
2 To cry or shed tears.

m. (-दः)
A cloud.
E.
क water, and द what gives.

ind.
When, at what time.
E.
किम् what, दा aff.

m. (-कः)
An awning.
E.
कद a cloud, and क what makes; yielding a shade as a cloud; also fem. कदका and कदकी.

n. (-रं)
A bad letter.
E.
कत् for कुत् and अक्षर a letter.

m. (-ध्वा)
A bad road.
E.
कत् for कुत् bad, and अध्वन a road.

n. (-नं)
1 Killing, destroying.
2

Sin.
3

War.
E.
कद to kill or injure, affix ल्युट्.

n. (-न्नं)
Bad food.
E.
कत् for कुत् bad, अन्न food.

m. (-म्बः)
1 A plant, commonly Kadamba (Nauclea kadamba.)
2 The mustard seed plant, (Sinapis dichotoma.)
3 A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratum): see देवताडक.
4 Turmeric.
n. (-म्बं)
A multitude, an assemblage or collection.
E.
कद to confound, &c. अम्बच् Uṇādi affix; also with कन् added कदम्बक.

n. (-म्बं)
1 A tree, (Nauclea cadamba.)
2 A drake, or, according to some, a teal.
3 An arrow.
f. (-म्बा)
A plant, commonly Muṇḍīrī: see कदम्बपुष्प.
E.
अण् added to कदम्ब.

mn. (-कः-कं)
See the preceding.

m. (-कः)
An arrow.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-दः)
Mustard seed plant: it seems to be a variety of reading for कदम्बक, q. v.

f. (-ष्पी)
A plant, the flowers, of which resemble those of the Kadamba, commonly called Muṇḍīrī.
E.
कदम्ब, and पुष्प a flower, fem. affix ङीष्; also with टाप्, कदम्बपुष्पा.

m. (-युः)
A fragrant breeze.
E.
कदम्ब the plant, and वायु wind.

m. (-लः)
1 A fragrant breeze.
2 Spring.
E.
कदम्ब, and अनिल wind.

m. (-रः)
1 A white sort of mimosa.
2 A corn, a callosity.
3 A saw.
4 An iron goad for an elephant.
n. (-रं)
Coagulated milk.
E.
क water, &c. दृ to tear, अच् aff.

Useless.
2

Unmeaning.
E.
कत् for कुत्, and अर्थ object.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Despised, disdained, rejected.
2 Rendered useless.
E.
कत् for कुत् bad, अर्थित sought.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Despised, disdained.
2 Rendered useless and unavailing.
E.
कदर्थ and कृत made, with च्चि augment.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
1 Avaricious, miserly.
2 Little, insignificant, mean.
3 Bad, disagreeable.
m. (-र्य्यः)
A miser.
E.
कत् bad, vile, and अर्य्य possessor.

Avarice.
2

Insignificance.
3 Badness.
E.
त्व added to the last; also with तल्, कदर्य्यता.

mf. (-लः-ली)
1 The plaintain tree, (Musa sapientum.)
2 Another plant, (Pistia stratiotes): see पृष्णी.
f. (-ला)
The silk cotton tree;
also (-ली-लिका)
1 A kind of deer, the hide of [] which is used as a seat, &c.
2 A flag, a banner.
3 A flag carried by an elephant.
E.
क water, air, &c. दल to pierce, to divide, &c. affix अच्, and टाप् or ङीष् fem. aff.

m. (-कः)
The plaintain or banana tree: see the preceding.
E.
कन् added to कदल.

f. (-ता)
1 A sort of cucumber.
2 A fine woman.

m. (-श्वः)
A hack, a bad horse.
E.
कत् for कुत्, and अश्व a horse.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Ill formed, ugly.
E.
कत् for कुत्, and आकार form.

n. (-ख्यं)
A plant, commonly Kurh or Kudh, (Costus speciosus.)
E.
कत् bad, आख्या name, ill named: having a bad name or reputation.

ind.
Sometime or other, ever; नकदाचन never.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Wicked, abandoned, following evil practices.
E.
कत् for कुत्, आचार observance.

ind.
Sometimes, at sometime or other, ever; नकदाचित् never.

ind.
Sometimes, now and then.
E.
कदा when, अपि certainly.

mfn. (ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं)
Tepid, warm.
n. (-ष्णं)
Warmth, gentle warmth.
E.
कत् instead of कुत् bad, inferior, उष्ण heat.

mfn. (-द्रुः-द्रुः-द्रु)
Tawny.
f. (-द्रुः)
The wife of KAŚYAPA the saint, and mother of the Nāgas or the serpent race, inhabiting the regions below the earth.
m. (-द्रुः)
Tawny, (the colour.)
E.
कभ to desire, डु affix, and र inserted; the final of the radical is irregularly changed to द; fem. affix ऊञ्.

m. (-त्रः)
A serpent.
E.
पुत्र a son, joined to the preceding; also other compounds of similar import, as कद्रुसुत, &c.

m. (-तः)
A serpent: see the preceding.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 Speaking ill, inaccurately, indistinctly, &c.
2 Vile, base, contemptible.
E.
कत् for कुत् bad, and वद who speaks.

n. (-रं)
The surface or skim of coagulated milk.
m. (-रः)
A spirituous liquor distilled from the flowers of the Kadamba.
f. (-री)
1 Wine, spirituous liquor in general.
2 A name of SARASVATĪ.
3 The female Koil or Indian cuckoo.
4 The female of another bird, (Turdus salica, BUC.)
E.
कदम्ब the Kadamba flower, र what gains or gets, from रा, affix ड.

n. (-जं)
Ferment, yeast, whatever occasions fermentation.
E.
कादम्बरी, and वीज seed.

m. (-र्य्यः)
The Kādamba tree: see कादम्ब.
E.
कादम्बरी a spirit, and यत् aff.

f. (-नी)
A long line of clouds.
E.
कादम्ब the Kādamba flower, इनि and ङीप्^1 affixes, implying a multitude; the clouds being compared he large white flowers of the Nauclea cadamba.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161212. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batches 309-312. note: missing virAma.

mfn. (-त्कः-त्की-त्कं)
Produced sometimes, occasional, incidental.
E.
कदाचित् sometimes, with कन् added, and अण् aff.

m. (-यः)
A Nāga or serpent of the race that is supposed to people the lower regions.
E.
कद्रु the mother of these beings, and ढक् aff.
